title: Prompt Revision as a Source of Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prompt revision layers using a Contextual Markedness Score (CMS) to measure semantic deviation from an unmarked baseline, and a Cultural Flattening Score (CFS) via TF-IDF to detect narrow, stereotypical vocabularies applied to 31 specific geographic and cultural contexts. The textual bias metrics are also correlated with image-level biases using Vision-Language Model (VQA) descriptions of the generated visual outputs in an ablation study.
